Trim into strength by Friday, keep core in staples with US-linked demand.

themes: Indonesia's crypto tax framework (0.1% PPh on gains) is a durable structural driver, as formalization boosts exchange volumes and institutional participation.

Local exchange consolidation under Bappebti licensing creates a moat for compliant platforms, making regulatory winners the primary long-term beneficiaries of retail inflows.
sectors.ai: Buy the dip on TRUMP and ENA for momentum into year-end; rotate out of laggards like XMR and LEO. Keep positions liquid—global risk-off can hit IDX-listed proxies harder than offshore tokens.
